about_the_game:
GUNJUTSU

💥 TRICKSHOTTING IS BACK. This is for the ones who never stopped spinning.

GUNJUTSU is a tribute to the golden age of Trickshotting—built for those who lived through the OG console era and designed to feel just like the good old days.

🎯 Master the Art of Trickshotting

  • Work your way down the 'Trickshot Iceberg', a fully-fledged tutorial system that will teach you every skill.

⚡ A Perfect Balance of Skill & Creativity

  • For the OG Trickshotters: A game with depth, challenge, and variety.

  • For newcomers: A step-by-step system that helps you grow into a Trickshot master.

HOW IT PLAYS:

🔥 Stay Airborne – Earn points only while in the air—land, and your score resets!
💀 Trick & Shoot – You only bank points if you hit the target.
🧩 A Puzzle-Shooter Like No Other – Every level is an open-ended Trickshot puzzle.

🎮 Compete Worldwide with quantitative skills – Climb the global Leaderboards and prove you're the best Trickshotter alive.

🚀 Wishlist GUNJUTSU now.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 / AMD FX-6300 (or any 4-core CPU at 2.5GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / Radeon R7 260X (2GB VRAM) or Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (or 6-core CPU at 3.0GHz+)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 Super / RX 580 / Intel Arc A750 (4GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: GUNJUTSU is a Trickshotting FPS that blends skill, creativity, and precision. This is a game about timing, not luck. Learn to perform mid-air gun tricks, 360 spins and noscopes. With an intuitive tutorial system, master new mechanics and become a Trickshotter.
